# FlowCastle SDK

> Middleware that adds a contact CRM, Live Chat with human handoff, broadcasts, goals and conversion analytics to a Telegram bot you already run in code — grammY, Telegraf, aiogram 3 or python-telegram-bot 21/22. The bot token never leaves your process; message content is filtered locally; handlers never wait on the network. Optionally, flows built visually in FlowCastle run through the same bot process. MIT.

Packages: `@flowcastle/grammy`, `@flowcastle/telegraf`, `@flowcastle/sdk-runtime` (npm) · `flowcastle` (PyPI, extras `[aiogram]` / `[python-telegram-bot]`).
Credential: one `fc_sdk_…` key from https://dashboard.flowcastle.ai → application → Add bot → Code SDK.

## Start here (agents)

- [Agent setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlowCastle/flowcastle-sdk/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): single-file install + option reference + verification checklist + troubleshooting for all four frameworks. Read this first.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlowCastle/flowcastle-sdk/main/README.md): positioning, snippets, privacy and performance contract.
